text:
nora (Billing): Quick heads-up — TheraNova invoice INV-4723 ($82,500) just failed: card declined by issuer (response: do_not_honor). Customer told account team they want to settle today. Need options: wire / ACH / manual retry.

maya (Finance): Stripe decline code: card_declined / issuer_declined. No 3DS triggered. Looks like BIN-level block for international transactions.

liam (Sales Ops): Customer asked for wire instructions on our side. I can collect bank details from them, but we should offer ACH as alternative if they have a US entity.

stripe-bot: PaymentIntent pi_3Jk9... status: requires_payment_method -> charge.failed (reason: card_declined).

nora (Billing): Draft wire template (send after legal OK and we confirm beneficiary acct):
```
Bank: First National Bank
Account name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Account number: 123456789
Routing/SWIFT: FNBOUS33XXX
Reference: INV-4723 / TheraNova
```

maya (Finance): Also recommend asking for a remittance screenshot once they initiate. If they can do ACH (originating in US), funds will clear faster and we can apply same-day.

liam (Sales Ops): Confirmed: TheraNova has US Ops entity and can do ACH. I'll request ACH details + preferred send date, and ask them to cc billing@redwood.ai.

carl (Finance Ops): I'll keep an eye on Stripe webhooks and reconcile once funds post. If they go wire route, please copy me on the bank details so I can prepare the posting instructions. :eyes:

nora (Billing): Plan: 1) Liam to confirm wire vs ACH with customer and paste final instructions here. 2) Maya to approve putting invoice on manual hold until funds post. 3) Carl to monitor and reconcile. If we don't hear back by EOD PST, we'll schedule one manual retry 24h later.

maya (Finance): Approved for hold once liam confirms. Please flag if they ask for payment terms change. :white_check_mark:

liam (Sales Ops): Will update in thread within the hour.

nora (Billing): Thanks — tagging for visibility. I'll mark invoice status as "payment_failed" and hold collection notices until we get final payment method.
